periods.description: Powered armor vehicles used for flight, land travel, combat, communication and guard duties. In vol-21 they function as royal transport, military equipment, and the center of the epilogue battle.
periods.principles: Pilots summon or equip Drag-Rides through Sword Devices, using cores, armor, weapons, roars and type-specific systems.
periods.classification: Wyvern/flying, Wyrm/land, Drake/special, EX variants, Divine Drag-Rides
periods.origin: Ancient and modernized military technology derived from ruins
